old: Stage 2K.1R4A (verify-artifacts only lists paths; sensitivity v5 has no per-scenario ledger)
new: Stage 2K.1R4B (real artifact manifest verifier + sensitivity v6 ledger + PIT valuation readiness review)

changes.problem: verify-artifacts only collected artifact_logical_path values from the capsule and returned pass; it never recomputed any hash.
changes.old: CLI verify-artifacts built a capsule and returned {status: pass, verified: [path, ...]} from resolved_records; no file content was checked.
changes.new: New module ashare_research.scoring.artifact_manifest.verify_artifact_manifest() recomputes each file's SHA-256 and byte_size over LF-normalized content (normalize_lf), validates the manifest structure (10 rules), and returns ArtifactManifestVerification with missing_files/hash_mismatches/size_mismatches/duplicate_paths/invalid_paths/manifest_digest. manifest_digest = SHA-256 of canonical JSON excluding manifest_digest.

changes.problem: The CLI passed 0 even when the manifest was stale or tampered.
changes.old: verify-artifacts returned pass unconditionally after collecting paths.
changes.new: verify-artifacts now calls the real verifier. New --manifest argument (defaults to the current stage's committed manifest). Exit codes: 0 all pass; 1 any manifest check failure; 2 missing manifest / unsupported schema / internal error; never 3 for manifest. --output preserves the real failure exit code.
changes.evidence: tests/test_m2_stage2k1r4b_artifact_and_sensitivity_audit.py::test_cli_verify_manifest_* (pass 0 / fail 1 / output preserves failure / missing 2 / uses real verifier)

changes.problem: Sensitivity v5 computed the summary directly from a side-channel outcome list; there was no per-scenario ledger, and confidence-threshold scenarios were not counted.
changes.old: sensitivity v5 had 6 logic classes but no per-scenario ledger; confidence thresholds lived only in the confidence_gate_sensitivity summary block; scenario_count excluded confidence scenarios; missing-ROIC had only synthetic_neutral and no_roic (no current_gap).
changes.new: sensitivity v6 adds a typed SensitivityScenario ledger (all 6 scenario classes incl. confidence_threshold and missing_roic with current_gap/synthetic_neutral/no_roic_component). scenario_id is deterministically derived from the canonical semantic payload. Each dimension's summary is recomputed entirely from the ledger (base/min/max/delta/band_flip/insufficient/confidence_block/veto/count/type_counts/stability). confidence_threshold scenarios are counted. ledger_digest and validate_sensitivity_ledger() independently recompute the summary and digest; any mismatch fails. New report petrochina_dimension_scoring_sensitivity_v6.json.
changes.evidence: tests/test_m2_stage2k1r4b_artifact_and_sensitivity_audit.py::test_sensitivity_* (six classes, current_gap, confidence counted, type counts match, unique ids, A/B digest, tamper fails, summary recomputable, gates independent, synthetic flags, tolerance 1.0, no overall/rank/target)

changes.problem: Whether historical PIT PE/PB/PS is implementable was not reviewed against the actual repo data.
changes.old: The valuation dimension used a close-price observation set; the PE/PB/PS historical percentile gap was left to this review.
changes.new: docs/pit_valuation_denominator_readiness_review.md and reports/pit_valuation_denominator_readiness_matrix.json record the actual inventory: market close present (unadjusted, 2021-01-04..2026-07-31) but no total_market_cap/total_shares in the frame; financial denominators annual-only (no quarterly), so TTM is not constructible; share timeline total-ordinary (A+H) non-canonical for market cap. Route comparison (A market-cap vs B per-share) and 4 implementation approaches. Decision: PIT_DENOMINATOR_FACT_ACQUISITION_REQUIRED; route UNRESOLVED (recommendation MARKET_CAP).
